title: SharePoint: Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet to delete brand font files
summary: The documented commands, visibility control, licensing context and roadmap facts check out. Microsoft documents the fallback for SharePoint pages, but the briefing also asserts that fallback for Viva Connections without supporting text. The checklist additionally names package inspection and editing controls absent from its table.

claims.claim: SharePoint is introducing Remove-SPOFontFile for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the brand center.
claims.quote: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing PowerShell support for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint Brand Center.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes SharePoint administrators removing fonts that are no longer approved, licensed or needed.
claims.quote: With the new Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet, SharePoint administrators can remove brand font files that are no longer approved, licensed, or needed across their organization in SharePoint.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Remove-SPOFontFile -Name <font file name> deletes the named custom brand font file.
claims.quote:
Remove-SPOFontFile -Name "Tahoma.ttf"
This example removes the SharePoint brand font file "Tahoma.ttf" from the brand fonts library across all geo locations.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a UI control for the tenant-wide, all-geo font-file deletion.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint brand font file Visible property PowerShell Set-SPOFontFile REST API hide font delete brand center UI. Opened Brand Fonts, brand center overview and Remove-SPOFontFile; deletion is documented as a cmdlet, not a UI operation.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: SharePoint brand center app > Brand Fonts library > font file > Visible controls the font's availability.
claims.quote:
To manage your custom brand fonts, you'll need to navigate to the Brand Fonts library in the Brand center app.
1. Select your custom font file from the library.
2. Edit the Visible property on your font file to control the availability of the font for experiences.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API or cmdlet for changing a custom font file's Visible property.
claims.quote: Searched: "brand font" "Visible" PowerShell API; SharePoint brand font file Visible property PowerShell Set-SPOFontFile REST API hide font delete brand center UI. Read Brand Fonts and font-package reference results; package hiding is not font-file visibility.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Remove-SPOFontPackage -Identity <font package GUID> removes a custom brand font package from the tenant.
claims.quote:
Remove-SPOFontPackage -Identity 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012
This example removes the font package with the specified GUID.

claims.claim: There is no documented brand center UI operation for deleting a font package.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint brand center delete font package app UI Remove-SPOFontPackage. Opened Font packages and Remove-SPOFontPackage. Font packages says packages cannot be deleted from the brand center app.

claims.quote: Searched: "Remove-SPOFontFile" default enable automatic. Read the roadmap record, Remove-SPOFontFile, Brand Fonts and brand center overview; none states a rollout default for the deletion cmdlet or an automatic change to existing fonts.
